# Recipe: Email Drive Link

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a gws recipe: find a Drive file, share it with the right permission (role + recipient), then email the link with a message to the recipient — the three steps of a manual share-and-notify compressed into one agent run. Composes two utility skills (gws-drive + gws-gmail), which must be loaded first. Requires the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it changes real sharing permissions — double-check the recipient and role before running; gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
